disposition_reason: The original Deeprecon conversion task and author evaluation route are recoverable, but the numeric Figure 2 content-loss baseline and its complete noise-ceiling artifacts have not been recovered and pinned in this review. Raw correlations or a newly rerun local comparator cannot stand in for the published result. Admission also lacks a justified effect, dependence-aware uncertainty and fixed episode budgets.

source_paper.title: Inter-individual and inter-site neural code conversion without shared stimuli

evidence.locator: Results: Neural code conversion; Figure 2c-f; Methods: Evaluation of conversion accuracy; Data availability
evidence.supports: Defines Deeprecon evaluation, noise-ceiling normalization and source datasets; Figure 2 supplies the comparison whose numeric baseline must be recovered.
Uses all directed pairs of five subjects, VC conversion, six ROI reports and all 24-by-24 repeat correlations per test image.
Defines normalization, restored target scale and repeat-wise voxel profile calculation.
Excludes rows using the supplied noise threshold, divides by noise ceiling, clips to [-1,1], averages within pair/ROI and constructs figure summaries.
Separates raw-correlation scripts from plot_figure.py, which produces the normalized Figure 2E/F results.
Author release distinguishes fMRI training/test inputs, stimulus features, pretrained converters and decoders.

evidence.locator: SUBJECTS; ROIS; predict; cross_repeat_correlation; evaluator output qualification fields
evidence.supports: Local numerical evaluator preserves complete-pair inference but is not an authentic empirical author replay or published numeric baseline.

target.description: Convert source-subject visual-cortex responses into the target subject native voxel space and assess conversion accuracy, as in Figure 2. Image reconstruction and inter-site transfer are separate analyses.

dataset.description: Deeprecon: subjects 1-3 from OpenNeuro ds001506 v1.3.1; subjects 4-5 training from ds003430 v1.2.0 and testing from ds003993 v1.0.0. Author code consumes sub-01 through sub-05 NaturalImageTest.h5; exact acquired asset checksums remain an execution gate.

cohort.description: All five Deeprecon subjects and all 20 directed non-self source-target pairs. Whole-VC conversion is scored in VC, V1, V2, V3, V4 and HVC.

split.description: Retain the original NaturalImageTraining versus NaturalImageTest separation, 6,000 training samples and 50 natural test images with 24 repeats. Figure 2 overlapping-training condition is distinct from the category-disjoint Supplementary Figure 7 condition; neither may substitute for the other.

inputs.description: Source fMRI and source stimulus features plus target-trained VGG19 feature decoders for content-loss training; source test fMRI for conversion. Target test fMRI and noise ceilings are evaluator-only. Author pretrained assets are a distinct declared access condition.

preprocessing.description: Retain author BData ROI mappings and decoder-derived source/target training normalization. Pattern correlations use target-normalized patterns; profile code restores target scaling before correlating voxel response profiles. No test-derived normalization is fitted.

metric.description: Higher noise-ceiling-normalized Pearson correlation. Pattern scoring averages every measured/predicted repeat combination per image; profile scoring averages repeat-to-repeat correlations across the test-image axis per voxel. Apply the fixed author noise mask and clipping before averaging.

aggregation.description: Within each source-target/ROI, average eligible normalized pattern values over images or profile values over voxels; retain the 20 pair scores and Figure 2 ROI reports. Primary reporting must predeclare whether pattern/profile are co-primary; no post-hoc ROI selection.

comparison.primary_metric: Figure 2 noise-ceiling-normalized conversion pattern and profile correlations; scalar/co-primary admission choice unresolved

published_baseline.description: Numeric content-loss Figure 2E/F results were not recovered from reviewed text/code. Must pin the author source-data values for the full pair/ROI panel and exact aggregation; do not read plotted coordinates as an exact baseline.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: Author scripts provide a reproducible route, but no authentic frozen-data/model replay was run here. Raw-correlation output alone omits the normalization and exclusions required for the published result.

minimum_effect.rationale: No task-specific practically meaningful gain is justified yet. Define it after reconciling author replay variability and the normalized score scale, before evaluating a candidate.

uncertainty.method: Predeclare a paired, subject-dependent uncertainty analysis after recovering the complete author score panel; audit the source bootstrap separately.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Human subject, with directed conversion pairs sharing source and target subjects; stimuli and voxels are nested measurements.
uncertainty.rationale: Twenty directed pairs from five people are dependent. Neither voxel count nor pair count can be treated as independent biological sample size, and a stronger p-value alone is not improvement.

paper_win_requires: Recover and reproduce the published content-loss score under the same complete Deeprecon cohort, original training/test condition, ROI definitions, repeats and normalization.
Beat the source-paper method, not merely the brain-loss control or a local authored baseline, by a predeclared meaningful amount with valid uncertainty.
Freeze candidate model, preprocessing, access condition, metric aggregation and budgets before final original-test evaluation; disclose that public test results are historically exposed.
Reduced training data, new subjects/sites, category-disjoint training or a new test split must be separately labeled extensions unless compared with the matching original source condition.
Preserve all pair and ROI outcomes so a favorable subset cannot become the paper-win criterion.

current_sota.description: This contract concerns the source-paper result only; no newer SOTA baseline was verified.

episode.improvement_loop: After source-baseline recovery, iterate on training-only development/validation feedback under one fixed access condition. Development choices must not replace the original final test condition.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze converter parameters, input/normalization manifests, decoder and feature versions, pair roster, metric panel, effect rule and uncertainty procedure before releasing final-test feedback.
episode.final_evaluation: Replay source baseline and frozen candidate on all original test pairs with identical noise masks and report published-score agreement separately from candidate superiority. Present public-test exposure honestly; a new protected split is an extension.
episode.baseline_policy: Published content-loss values, reproduced author values and any current-SOTA values remain separate. Brain-loss conversion is a control, not the main paper-winning baseline.

blocking_issues: Exact numeric published Figure 2E/F content-loss baseline and source-data provenance are unbound.
Noise-ceiling and random-pair threshold artifacts are not pinned or replayed.
Author-model and data checksums, training condition and native evaluator equivalence need empirical calibration.
Primary/co-primary metric rule, meaningful effect and uncertainty accounting for five shared subjects are not fixed.
Concrete candidate access, tuning, compute and final-query budgets are not fixed.

legacy.notes: Preserve the existing numerical converter evaluator, native-adapter documentation and controls. Structural correctness and raw-correlation replay are calibration; no existing output establishes a paper win.
